In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two major stories shaping the Indian economy and global markets:
Story 1: Why Hormuz Isn't Back to Normal Yet
The Strait of Hormuz may have reopened after the US-Iran conflict, but global trade is far from normal. This story explores how mines, damaged oil infrastructure, high insurance costs, and legal uncertainty continue to disrupt one of the world's most important energy routes, keeping oil markets and global supply chains on edge.
